text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Books are spectacular. Wouldn't you
agree?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fiction, nonfiction, even lexicons...
Knowledge is
sustenance, the true
phronesis in life.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A person hiding their lack of wisdom
behind
flowery language is equivalent to
vanitas
vanitatum.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To reveal one's truest self, one need
only wear
the garb of truth itself.
